title: Personal rules: a risk line states in its label whether it is open or fixed
summary: GLOBAL_CLAUDE.md's line-labelling rule (v35) asks for Risk (open): or Risk (fixed): with the decided four-line example; older-orion offer tests use a copy capped at v17 only where needed. Version 35.
friction: Several sessions on one machine ran full suites under two different locks (C:/wt/gate.lock.d and C:/git/DaVinci-wt/suite.lock) that do not see each other; agreed mid-run to use the DaVinci run-suite.sh lock for all orion runs. Grillo still uses the older lock.
lessons_learned: Adapting a test fixture to a new version bump can silently drop a boundary case; review caught it by mutation testing. Keep a fixture override scoped to the scenarios that need it.
